Dharma Sanskrit recitation

2.47.mp3 is AI-generated Sanskrit chant of Bhagavad Gita 2.47, generated on
2026-10-03 with the public prathoshap/vagdhenu-demo service (auto-detected
anustubh meter, seed 60). It was converted from WAV to 96 kbps MP3.
This is synthetic audio, not a recording of a pandit reciting this verse.

Model: Vagdhenu, developed by Prof. Prathosh, IISc Bengaluru.
https://huggingface.co/prathoshap/vagdhenu
https://github.com/prathoshap/vagdhenu
The model author publishes his own voice for Sanskrit recitation, study and
accessibility. No identity, endorsement or flawless pronunciation is claimed.

Model/code contribution: Apache-2.0; upstream dependencies include AI4Bharat
IndicF5 (MIT), F5-TTS and NVIDIA BigVGAN-v2. See their respective licenses.
No model weights or third-party source code are distributed with this website.

Other verses are generated only when the visitor presses Recite. The hosted
service currently limits generation to ten shlokas per day per network and
may also be subject to GPU availability. The browser caches up to 20 chants
for replay. The complete selected Sanskrit text, without its reference digits,
is sent to that service. The reader's original displayed text is unchanged.

Every one of the 701 reader entries also supports browser read-aloud when a
Sanskrit or Hindi speech voice is available. A failed/timed-out AI request
switches to this fallback; Read aloud now skips waiting. The app reads every
line of the current verse, including speaker introductions, never a substitute
sample. Sanskrit voices are preferred; Hindi voices are explicitly identified
because Sanskrit pronunciation and chanting cadence can differ. This fallback
is labelled Voice rather than AI, and is not represented as a pandit recording
or as the Vagdhenu model. Voice availability and quality depend on the device.
The selected speech provider may process speech remotely; local-only processing
is not guaranteed. The app does not send questions or translations for speech.
